saw_lines: Appliance buyers replace a machine every few years, so they compare on one question: does it arrive intact and work?
So sales are lost at the first click, when new buyers see no free shipping promise and no proof to trust.
Your 2 ads carry no proof number, so collect one hard figure, such as a review count or orders shipped, and open the next ad with it.
ads_1: Video ads leading with free shipping over $150, tested against a delivery angle
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, TikTok and X
